author: agent
sentences: This year I finally rebuilt my home office from scratch.
The standing desk alone cost $1,450, and it was worth every cent.
I share the room with 2 cats, so every cable now sits in a tray under the desk.
The biggest change was the chair, though.
My back pain is *gone*, and I can work a full day again.
Buy the chair first, then the desk.
notes: a price over $1,000; one emphasized word; 2 cats is a bare small number and no event
